# VO 0.2.4
- Paste Last Dictation. If another app grabbed focus while you were talking, click the text box you meant and press Control + Option + Command + V. VO pastes your last finished dictation again, keeps your clipboard as it was, and still works after VO restarts. You can switch it to Control + Option + Command + L, or turn it off, in Settings → Paste Last Dictation. - Fixed VO sometimes freezing for a minute or more after you finished talking, with the waveform stuck and nothing pasted. It happened when the app that last copied something to your clipboard stopped responding. VO now waits at most half a second for it, then pastes and leaves your dictation on the clipboard. - Right Command and Right Control can now start dictation too, alongside Right Option. - The cleanup pass no longer invents text, and handles spoken corrections ("no wait", "scratch that", "I mean") properly. The cloud cleanup model is now gpt-4.1-mini, and local cleanup defaults to qwen3.5:4b-nvfp4, which runs on Ollama's faster MLX engine. - New installs start with on-device dictation and the cleanup pass off, so VO works out of the box with no API key. Existing settings are left as they are. - What's New. After VO updates itself, a small "What's New" link appears at the top right of the VO window and at the top of the menu bar menu. It shows what changed, like this list, and goes away once you've read it. - Includes the 0.2.3 change: updates install themselves once you have been idle for two minutes.

# VO 0.2.3
- Updates now install themselves. VO is never quit, so a downloaded update used to wait for a relaunch that never came. It now relaunches into the new version once you have been away from the keyboard for two minutes and nothing is recording. The VO menu also gets an "Install VO x.y.z and Relaunch" item while an update is waiting. - One last manual step: this mechanism arrives with 0.2.3, so if an older VO is running, quit it once (or install this disk image) to get there. From then on it looks after itself.

# VO 0.2.2
- Dictation now works while Settings is open. The microphone level meter in Settings steps aside for dictation, voice commands and meetings, says that it is paused, and comes back on its own. - Includes the 0.2.1 changes: Check for Updates in the VO menu, and the time-saved readout in days, weeks and months.
